title: Private Tour of Gorgeous Victoria and to Butchart Gardens! (4 hr)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

We are able to accommodate one or more collapsible wheelchairs if the guest is able to get in and out of the van. Wheelchair rentals are also available at the Butchart Gardens. Contact us for details.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our private tour is an excellent choice for guests who want a more personal, comfortable, and memorable experience. Our guides are friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely personable — we love sharing the stories, history, and hidden gems of the area while making every guest feel welcome and relaxed. Because it’s a private tour, we can move at your pace, answer questions along the way, and create a more engaging experience tailored to your interests.

Travel is also part of the experience, which is why we use a very comfortable high-roof van for large groups. A luxury minivan may be used for groups of 4 or less if the large van is booked.
